provider.description: AI provider to add (run again with the other one to add it alongside). Default: the installed one, else openrouter

chat.description: Add the client AI chat (sessions, messages, SSE streaming). Needs auth-client

quota.description: Add per-user chat limits: AI_DAILY_MESSAGES and AI_MONTHLY_TOKENS (needs --chat)

force.description: Overwrite generated files that you have edited

skipInstall.description: Do not run npm install (nothing to install: providers use fetch)

root.description: Project directory relative to the current directory
